answer_1.quote: We have conduct experiments on a variety of text generation tasks: machine translation, tableto-text, image captioning, commonsense genteration, and keyword-to-dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs from various NLG systems in benchmark datasets

answer_2.quote: We included top-performing baseline metrics which joined each challenge, including n-gram based metrics: BLEU, chrF, METEOR and CIDEr; Unsupervised learned metrics: PRISM, BARTScore, BERTScore, and SEScore2; LLM-based metrics: GPT3-Dav3 and GPT4; Supervised learned metrics: BLEURT-20, MaTESe, UniTE and MetricX XXL.

answer_4.quote: We employed three human annotators to assess the alignment of our model before and after refinement.
answer_4.guideline: Human Evaluation Instructions: M1: Error type descriptions are not consistent with explanation M2: Error locations are not consistent with the explanation M3: Error locations are not referred in the output text M4: Error locations can not refer to the output text M5: Major and minor labels do not correspond to the correct severity levels M6: The explanation is wrong. However, error at a specified location does exist. G1: Error described in the explanation is not an error G2: One error is mentioned more than once among explanations G3: Incorrect phrase and correct phrase are not correctly aligned G4: One error span mentions multiple errors
